title: Coachella
metaDescription: Coachella is the annual two-weekend music and arts festival at the Empire Polo Club in Indio, California

overview.about: Coachella is one of the most influential music festivals in the world, held over two weekends each April at the Empire Polo Club in Indio, California. As famous for its fashion, art installations and celebrity crowd as for its genre-spanning headliners, it sets trends far beyond the desert.
overview.nextEvent: The next Coachella runs over two identical weekends in April at the Empire Polo Club in Indio. Multiple stages host pop, hip-hop, rock and electronic headliners, with large-scale art and installations spread across the grounds.
